## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. Include regression coverage for defects and both
positive and negative controls for new evaluation behavior. Redact private paths and data.

## Compatibility and scope

Describe changes to task schemas, CLI exits, evaluator identity or saved artifacts.
List known limitations and work intentionally left outside this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has observable acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Relevant tests and the complete local harness pass.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] Public files and packages contain no credentials, private data or internal notes.
- [ ] Added content can be distributed under the project's MIT license.
